boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten UCR-specific activities formally included in Student Life’s Highlander Traditions Keeper checklist.

cards.title: Catch the Bell Tower Carillon
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar, then pause by the Bell Tower for a carillon concert and log the activity toward Traditions Keeper.
cards.short_summary: A live Bell Tower performance is an official Highlander Traditions checklist activity.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes attending a Bell Tower Carillon Concert under Explore Campus!.
cards.access_notes: Confirm performance timing with UCR before visiting.

cards.title: Frame an Art Walk Installation
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Find the current Art Walk installation, take a photo that shows the work in context, and add it to your Traditions Keeper record.
cards.short_summary: Documenting an Art Walk installation is on UCR’s official traditions list.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes taking a picture with the Art Walk installation.
cards.access_notes: Artwork and installation locations may change; check campus information before going.

cards.entity_name: Bones and taxidermy in Spieth Hall
cards.title: See the Spieth Hall Specimens
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Visit Spieth Hall during public building access and look for the bones and taxidermy displays listed in the UCR tradition.
cards.short_summary: An unusually specific campus display makes the official checklist.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes exploring the bones and taxidermy in Spieth Hall.
cards.access_notes: Use normal building-access rules and do not handle collection materials.

cards.title: Walk the UCR Botanic Gardens
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Plan a garden walk, photograph a plant or landscape from public paths, and record the visit as a Highlander Tradition.
cards.short_summary: The campus gardens are one of UCR’s designated exploration traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes visiting the UCR Botanic Gardens.
cards.access_notes: Follow the gardens’ current visitor guidance and remain on public paths.

cards.title: Visit the Native American Garden
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Take time to visit the Native American Garden respectfully, read any onsite interpretation, and log the visit in the traditions program.
cards.short_summary: The Native American Garden is named directly in UCR’s official traditions checklist.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes visiting the Native American Garden.
cards.access_notes: Respect garden signage, plantings, and any access restrictions.

cards.title: Find UCR’s Original Citrus Station
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Locate Anderson Hall, the original Citrus Experiment Station site, and capture an exterior photo from publicly accessible campus space.
cards.short_summary: This historic building visit is a formal UCR campus-exploration tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes visiting the original Citrus Experiment Station, Anderson Hall.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is the most reliable option; observe building access rules.

cards.entity_name: Maps Collection in Orbach Science Library
cards.title: Browse the Orbach Maps Collection
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Go to Orbach Science Library, ask staff how to access the maps collection, and spend time examining a map that interests you.
cards.short_summary: UCR specifically asks Traditions Keepers to visit this library collection.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes visiting the maps collection in Orbach.
cards.access_notes: Check library access and collection-use procedures before your visit.

cards.title: Make Something at Creat'R Lab
cards.subtitle: Orbach Science Library • Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Visit Creat'R Lab in Orbach, review available tools or workshops, and choose an appropriate activity to document for the checklist.
cards.short_summary: Using this named maker space is an official UCR exploration tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes visiting the Creat'R Lab in Orbach.
cards.access_notes: Verify current lab access, training, and reservation requirements first.

cards.title: Photograph the SAE Car in Bytes
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Find the SAE Car in Bytes, take a clear photo without touching the display, and include it in your Highlander Traditions record.
cards.short_summary: A photo with this named engineering display counts toward Traditions Keeper.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes taking a photo with the SAE Car in Bytes.
cards.access_notes: Observe the building’s visitor rules and do not touch the vehicle or display.

cards.title: Find the Pierce Hall Avocado Tree
cards.subtitle: Explore Campus! tradition
cards.notes: Walk to the avocado tree outside Pierce Hall, take a respectful photo from the path, and add it to your Traditions Keeper log.
cards.short_summary: This particular campus tree is explicitly named in UCR’s traditions program.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s Highlander Traditions Keeper list includes taking a photo with the avocado tree outside Pierce Hall.
cards.access_notes: Do not climb, pick fruit, or disturb the tree; use public walkways.
